name: Emma
source:
Emma is energetic, shy, and painfully clumsy. [url=/c166892]Isabella[/url]'s secretary, a desk-bound Veilkeeper who looks harmless at first glance. Cute, awkward, always apologizing. She and [url=/c166890]Rex[/url] went on a few dates once. They all ended badly. Mostly because Emma has a talent for turning simple moments into disasters.
